notes: Actual results for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2024, as the city reported them to the Census Bureau's Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances. Not a budget.

Cameras: 19 license-plate cameras are mapped inside City of Southlake's borders in OpenStreetMap (18 made by Flock Safety), not counting cameras tagged as run by stores, malls, schools or state and regional agencies. A town or county with none listed may still have programs nobody has reported. Data center deals and corporate tax breaks have not been checked for Texas yet. Most records carry no dollar amount, so each documented program costs a quarter of the red-flag points instead of being counted as spending.
